title: ResearchTask
description: A research task (ADR 0039): a record an agent creates to group its work. Jobs carry its `task_id` and research records link it (`task:ID`); the coordinator derives both when the task is read.

task_id.title: TaskId
task_id.description: AblationKit task identifier (UI- or agent-first task).

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

created_by.title: ResearchActor
created_by.description: Who made a change: a human session, an agent token or the system. Work under a task links the task (`task:ID`).

created_at.title: Timestamp
created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

updated_at.title: Timestamp
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

criteria.description: What would settle the goal, as the agent wrote it. Optional.

status.title: TaskStatus
status.description: `open` while the agent works on it; `completed` with an outcome and a notebook of the vault (or a report record); `abandoned` by the agent or the researcher, with a reason.

outcome.title: TaskOutcome
outcome.description: The research outcome a completed task reports. `supported` and `not_supported` need a notebook with a note that cites runs, or a report that cites evidence.

report_id.description: The report record a completed task points at.

notebook_id.description: The vault notebook a completed task points at (ADR 0049): what the task established, as the notes it wrote, compiled.

conclusion.description: The answer to the goal in a few sentences, as the agent wrote it when it completed the task: what was found and what it means. Markdown with LaTeX.

agenda_item.description: The item of the researcher's agenda this task serves (ADR 0058): `note:<id>` or `L<n>`.

closed_at.title: Timestamp
closed_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

closed_by.title: ResearchActor
closed_by.description: Who made a change: a human session, an agent token or the system. Work under a task links the task (`task:ID`).
